q: The Brunerie number β (Brunerie 2016) is an integer defined as the value of a specific HoTT-definable element β: ℤ, computed by a homotopy-theoretic argument involving π₄(S³). Its value was computed to be:
exp: Brunerie proved in HoTT that β ∈ {±1, ±2}, and later verified computationally (in a cubical proof assistant) that β = 2. This corresponds to the classical result π₄(S³) = ℤ/2ℤ, with the generator having Hopf invariant 2. The computation required years of work in the Agda proof assistant.
